item_short_desc: Rothco's Athletic Fit Camo T-shirt is made from a super comfortable cotton/poly ring spun material.
description: Rothco's Athletic Fit Camo T-shirt is made from a super comfortable cotton/poly ring spun material. This camo shirt features a slightly smaller chest, smaller armholes and smaller sleeve opening for a more athletic fit t-shirt. Tagless label and inset collar for maximum comfort no matter where you go.
